mapper.insert: INSERT INTO habit (name, is_public, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{isPublic}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO user_habit (member_id, habit_id, status, frequency, start_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{habitId}, 'ACTIVE', #{frequency}, #{startDate}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO user_habit_schedule (user_habit_id, day_of_week, times_per_week, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userHabitId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{timesPerWeek}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO habit_category (habit_id, category_id, created_at) VALUES (#{habitId}, #{categoryId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT uh.id, h.name, uh.frequency, uh.status, uhs.day_of_week FROM user_habit uh JOIN habit h ON uh.habit_id = h.id LEFT JOIN user_habit_schedule uhs ON uh.id = uhs.user_habit_id WHERE uh.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY uh.id DESC, uhs.day_of_week ASC
